Revenge of the Beefsteak Tomatoes.name: Revenge of the Beefsteak Tomatoes
Revenge of the Beefsteak Tomatoes.summary: Your objective is to trap the Tomato Plants at the bottom of the screen by building three walls above them. At the same time you must avoid or shoot down all flying Tomatoes, dodge Tomato Bombs and stop the Brick-Eaters.
